synopsis: EN 474 is presented as the European counterpart of ISO 20474: a type-C earth-moving machinery safety series whose 2022 family includes EN 474-1 and machine-specific parts [f2717, f15238, f15243]. Great Britain designated that family through a notice dated 8 August 2026, providing a presumption-of-conformity route under the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008, limited to the standard's scope [f15244, f15080]. Although several facts identify the notice as 0139/26, the booklet explicitly says that number was not confirmed on the gov.uk notices page [f2220, f2760, f2875]. Designation does not supply an automatic-braking test or performance matrix; braking-performance evidence must instead come from ISO 21815, ISO 19014 and the safety case [f2720, f15245, f15248]. Harmonisation of EN 474 or EN ISO 21815 under Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 remained unverified because the European Commission was still preparing the list in 2026 [f2209, f15081].
